data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from nonblack-brigandish-guillemot: its closing plan review raised this as an advisory finding. ADR 0125 replaced repository-pinned op-cert keys with validity-only verification plus an optional per-environment trust list, and the stories under that epic removed the pin file and updated docs and runbooks. User-facing messages in `src` still describe the old model:

- `src/rebar/_store/env_identity.py:176`, the re-identify warning, says `verify.require_environment` "trusts only the own or pinned keys of the environment it names".
- `src/rebar/_store/env_identity.py:64` says a key will "fail as `mismatch` unless that key is pinned".

No story's scope or grep check covered `src` prose, so these survived.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both messages describe the ADR 0125 model: validity-only by default, `verify.trusted_opcert_keys` when the verifying environment sets it.
- [ ] `git grep -n -i 'pinned key\|own or pinned\|unless that key is pinned' -- src` prints nothing.
- [ ] Any test that asserts the old wording is updated in the same change.
data.title: Re-identify warnings still describe pinned op-cert keys
